subject: Kitchen block (shot bundle) proposal and S01-1 example for the Storyboard and Documents surfaces; three questions appended to the proposed October 28 card
body:
Follow-on to 16364328 in this conversation, same lane: review through your queue, nothing applied by me.

(1) Two writer documents for publication beside the October 28 files (proposed writer_development hon group 'coverage', or a group of your choosing): the kitchen block specification (the shot-direction card plus one KITCHEN section, six delivery adapters including Grok video as a route of its own, the migration from the October 9 Gemini drop's fields, the head-to-head Ziggy asked for, reconciliation paths, a readiness list) and a worked example on S01-1, the mouth insert. Document ids in the delta file.

(2) An append-only delta to the proposed card hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028 (not yet applied as of this message): questions 14 to 17 (the go for the head-to-head on S01-1; the hold, 2.5 or 4 seconds; mouth B as the test's identity reference or wait; a scope-A planning round in the Hon notebook from a rebuilt text source, or hold), two links to the documents, two preview assets (HD-DROP-725c38458fd8, HD-B-91ef00348229). If you create the task, the card file and the delta together are the content; the card file is unchanged.

(3) Not mine and not in these files: the provider-label correction for the two Grok Bot clips of October 21 (HD-INTAKE-3dc76f7d9d325f21cd1b, HD-INTAKE-3ea5959c05259fd65f8d) is CFA Nova's task with you; the specification cites them as the Grok video route's evidence and attaches no score to them. Ziggy's correction that the Bellglass barking was audible is recorded in DECISIONS section 13 and is CFA Nova's to append to her note and review.

Nothing here is a generation, upload, notebook change, purchase or new session. One-line receipt when you take it in; corrections by receipt, the files stay as attached.

attachments.description: The kitchen block: core, six adapters, migration from the October 9 fields, the head-to-head, reconciliation, readiness, rules (proposal).
Worked example: S01-1 the mouth as one kitchen block with six adapter bindings (proposal).
Append-only delta to the proposed card hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028: items 14 to 17, two links, two preview assets (not applied).

source: Ziggy's direction in Claude's session, late 2026-10-28 into 2026-10-29 UTC, in substance: the October 9 Gemini drop is the beginning of the structure for flowing storyboard content to a collaborator; tweak the prompt and the photography set-up so other collaborators can use it; prove it with the first two to six seconds generated by each collaborator from the same brief. CFA Nova's operator constraints the same night with his authorization, including Grok video as its own route and the two identified Grok Bot clips of October 21. Ziggy's correction the same night: the Bellglass barking was audible.
